summary: Carded from live Pod logs the user surfaced during the MPI-467 GPU smoke matrix. Id claimed with exclusive mkdir per MPI-488.

Scope CORRECTED before any work started. The card claimed two defects; the second (stage-all thrashes whenever the set exceeds container disk) does not exist - MPI-329 already mirrors the GPU Pod's container disk to the network volume (455 GB for aghcuvg7nl), so eviction never fires there. The 20 GB seen in the evidence is CONTAINER_DISK_CPU_GB, a RunPod hard cap on CPU Pods. One real defect remains: staging runs at all on a download-mode Pod that has no ComfyUI to serve it.
